author: Plochem
body:
Hey guys,

I just have some ideas for the server so please do not hate comment. Also, the staff can debate about the cost of the boosters depending on the x2 or x3 boosters or time the boosters do.

1. CREDIT BOOSTERS

You can add this in the shop for personal or network credit multiplier.

- Personal credit multipliers are basically x2 credit boosters for yourself. It can last for 2 hours? Or one hour?  I don't know if this violates EULA so...

- Network credit multipliers benefits the whole everyone in the whole server. It could be x2 or x3 network credit boosters. This can last for 2 hours maybe? Or 3 hours? I will let the staff debate about this. There will be network boosters for Nebula, Walls, Survival Games, Nexus, or King of the Hill.

Ex: I buy a x3 network credit booster for Nebula. This x3 booster affects everyone playing in the whole Nebula Server. As a result, those people will have their credit rewards for their kills and monument destructions tripled.

2. DOUBLE OR TRIPLE CREDIT HOLIDAY/WEEKEND!!!! :DDD

- So the avicus staff will decide whether they should triple or double the credit reward for the WHOLE server on major holidays or weekends or summers such as Christmas, Easter, some weekends, summer, black Friday, etc.
